messages.subject: Project Tamarisk — Licence v3 (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

v3 circulated separately (tracked). We've accepted your 4.5% royalty, the 2x liability cap, the 30 June 2029 longstop and the deemed sub-licence consent. The single change we're asking for in return is the minimum annual royalty from Year 3, which we've moved from £350,000 to £500,000 to reflect the lower rate. Subject to that, we think we're there.

Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP
